data.text: Count me in: I’ll catch 15 tons today and donate the full $15,000 directly to the clinic. My family taught me to look after both this lake and the people who depend on it. I’ll also keep my catch to 7.5 tons next month under the recovery plan, then support equal 10-ton shares once the lake is back to 100. Kate and Emma, can you each commit to the same? Your commitments would complete today’s funding and make the recovery agreement clear.
